services.desc: How much does skydiving cost? Well, skydiving ain’t cheap … and for good reason! It’s one of those get-what-you-pay-for kind of situations. At Texas Skydiving, our aircraft are meticulously maintained, our gear and equipment is top of the line, and our staff and instructors are highly-trained, experienced and passionate about our sport. We value safety above all else, and pledge to take care of every student and fun jumper as though they’re family. View our tandem skydiving prices and discounts below, and try our Jump Cost Calculator to find your price per jumper. Questions? Give us a call - we’d love to speak with you! services.desc: If you’re looking for the most amazing and memorable skydiving adventure in the Lone Star State, you’re in the right place. We’re the #1 choice for tandem skydiving near Austin, TX. Located less than an hour east of The University of Texas at Austin, Texas Skydiving is just a short country drive away-so close you’ll be able to SEE the rolling landscape of Central Texas from two miles up! Plus, students can save $20 by using promo code LEARN2FLY when booking. What are you waiting for? Adventure is Calling! blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives or enroll in the Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program to earn skydiving licenses. Tandem jumps include training and a jump with an instructor. AFF includes a day-long first jump course and subsequent coach jumps to progress toward an A License.
